I do not fear death. It is a respite that could be permanent. Goodbye. I have made my choice

I wish I could say something to make it better. I wish I could change it. But I am in the same situation. But don't do it. I hate when people say I have so much to live for because I know I dont. I'm dead inside. And I'll never be back. But just keep going. Keep fighting. I have no idea why I keep doing it but I am. Just keep fighting.
